scripts.bdd:generate: npm run bdd:classify && npm run bdd:validate-contracts && npx bddgen --config playwright.bdd.config.ts
scripts.test:bdd:readonly: npm run bdd:generate && npx playwright test --config playwright.bdd.config.ts --project=desktop --grep @readOnly --workers=4
scripts.test:bdd:mutable: npm run bdd:generate && npx playwright test --config playwright.bdd.config.ts --project=desktop --grep @mutable --workers=1
scripts.test:bdd: rimraf allure-results && npm run bdd:generate && npx playwright test --config playwright.bdd.config.ts --project=desktop
scripts.test:bdd:tags: npm run bdd:generate && npx playwright test --config playwright.bdd.config.ts --grep
scripts.test:bdd:smoke: npm run bdd:generate && npx playwright test --config playwright.bdd.config.ts --project=desktop --grep @smoke
scripts.test:bdd:regression: npm run bdd:generate && npx playwright test --config playwright.bdd.config.ts --project=desktop --grep @regression
scripts.test:bdd:ui: npm run bdd:generate && npx playwright test --config playwright.bdd.config.ts --ui
scripts.test:bdd:ui:watch: npm run bdd:generate && concurrently --kill-others "chokidar \"features/**/*.feature\" -c \"npm run bdd:generate\"" "npx playwright test --config playwright.bdd.config.ts --ui"
scripts.test:bdd:debug: npm run bdd:generate && npx playwright test --config playwright.bdd.config.ts --project=desktop --debug
scripts.allure:report: npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
